lead: Anil Kumble has built a public profile as an Indian cricketer, born on 17 October 1970 in Bengaluru.
As of 2026, he is 55 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Karnataka cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
This profile collects the Anil facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Anil Kumble — Career and Professional Work
paras: Anil Kumble works primarily as a cricketer.
